Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1453
Claimant:
Tracy Edwards
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
05/09/2024
The claim was reported by the claimant's representing attorney's office after a rear-end collision at a signalized
intersection. The insured vehicle was struck from behind whlie stopped, and the claimant reported neck and back
discomfort at the scene.
06/04/2024
The driver of the insured vehicle is not named on the policy and does not live with the policyholder, so driver status is
being reviewed against the policy terms. A recorded statement has been requested through counsel.
06/27/2024
Photos submitted by the claimant show the rear bumper area and the front of the claimant's vehicle. The images
confirm some of the reported impact details, but there are no independent witnesses to the collision.
06/30/2024
It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting at the time of impact, and the seating position will need
to be confirmed before injury causation is assessed. The claimant has described the seating position consistently so
far.
07/26/2024
The claimant told the same account of the collision in every conversation with this office, including the initial report
and the follow-up call with counsel present. No inconsistencies have been noted in the timeline of events.
07/31/2024
No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims history, and nothing suggests the damage occurred
before the policy coverage started. Prior ownership reocrds are being requested to confirm this.
08/30/2024
It is not clear whether all of the damage to the claimant's vehicle came from this impact, so an independent estimate
has been ordered to spearate any pre-existing wear from new damage.
09/08/2024
Medical records show a diagnosis of back strain. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the records
received so far, but prior provider history has been requested.
09/23/2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the treating provider's ntoes have been
requested to review the treatment plan and its link to the collision.
10/09/2024
It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash or from another cause. The medical reviewer has been
asked to give an opinion on causation once the full records are in.
10/25/2024
Next steps are to obtain the outstanding records, complete the damage estimate review, and schedule a follow-up
with counsel. The file will remain open pending these items.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
